description: Read cached Yahoo analyst consensus revenue/EPS estimates and available EPS revision percentages for one exact Bullrun ticker. A free background refresh checks supported symbols on demand, storing at most one snapshot per day; the first read may be empty. Fiscal periods and source currency are preserved. The configured feed does not provide EBITDA estimates, management guidance or revenue revisions. Forward P/E/PEG context uses the latest annual consensus snapshot only when quote and EPS currency units match. Read-only research operation. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

periodType.description: Return annual estimates, quarterly estimates, or both.

ticker.description: The ticker exactly as listed on Bullrun, e.g. "AAPL", "CRWD", "SPGI".

name: get_forward_estimates
title: Get forward estimates
